reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. An attacker can trigger this via the OAuth authorization endpoint (GET /oauth/authorize) by submitting a crafted scope query parameter containing arbitrary scopes (e.g., 'admin sensitive_scope'), causing the consent page to store the unchecked scopes in the authorization code and the token endpoint to issue a JWT embedding those arbitrary scopes, granting resource servers access beyond what the application was ever authorized to receive. The string 'allowed_scopes' is entirely absent from the codebase, confirming the enforcement mechanism specified in the invariant ('req.scope ⊆ application.allowed_scopes') is never implemented.
